QUOTE: "Always Allow/Deny" writes new patterns back to project config through `PermissionPersister`. I did not trace the persister's write path in depth.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions a `PermissionPersister` writing to project config, but it never names `config.local.yaml` or the append mechanism. It also doesn't separate persistence from the in-memory `add_permission` call.
